name: Curl-Flat

copy.title: CURL-FLAT
copy.description: Creates a high-low read on the flat defender.

football.read: High-low the flat defender: he sinks under the curl → flat; he widens to the flat → curl. Mirrored so the QB picks the better side pre-snap.

sources: Project handoff #1 — canonical presentation, route depths and relationship
Curl-flat: Cover 2 beater, mirrored both sides (most common 2x2 presentation)
